250: func TestFormatLedgerSuccess(t *testing.T) {
251: 	for _, tc := range successTestCases {
252: 		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
253: 			actual, err := FormatLedger(tc.currency, tc.locale, tc.entries)
254: 			if err != nil {
255: 				t.Fatalf("FormatLedger for input named %q returned unexpected error %v", tc.name, err)
256: 			}
257: 			expected := tc.expected[1:] // Strip initial newline
258: 			if actual != expected {
259: 				t.Fatalf("FormatLedger for input named %q failed\ngot:\n%s\nwant:\n%s", tc.name, actual, expected)
260: 			}
261: 		})
262: 	}
263: }

```go
type Entry struct {

	Description string

func FormatLedger(currency string, locale string, entries []Entry) (string, error) {
	if currency != "USD" && currency != "EUR" {
		return "", errInvalid
	}
	if locale != "en-US" && locale != "nl-NL" {
		return "", errInvalid
	}

	// Work on a copy so the caller's slice is not mutated.
	sorted := make([]Entry, len(entries))
	copy(sorted, entries)
	sort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool {
		if sorted[i].Date != sorted[j].Date {
			return sorted[i].Date < sorted[j].Date
		}
		if sorted[i].Description != sorted[j].Description {
			return sorted[i].Description < sorted[j].Description
		}
		return sorted[i].Change < sorted[j].Change
	})

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(header(locale))
	for _, entry := range sorted {
		line, err := formatRow(currency, locale, entry)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		b.WriteString(line)
	}
	return b.String(), nil
}
```

```go
func formatCents(cents int, thousandsSep, decimalSep string) string {
	s := strconv.Itoa(cents)
	switch len(s) {
	case 1:
		s = "00" + s
	case 2:
		s = "0" + s
	}
	intPart := s[:len(s)-2]
	decPart := s[len(s)-2:]

	// group the integer part in thousands from the right
	var grouped string
	for len(intPart) > 3 {
		grouped = thousandsSep + intPart[len(intPart)-3:] + grouped
		intPart = intPart[:len(intPart)-3]
	}
	grouped = intPart + grouped
	return grouped + decimalSep + decPart
}
```
